Exxon Mobil (XOM) Holder Loring Wolcott & Coolidge Fiduciary Advisors Llp Has Decreased Its Position as Stock Price Declined; Apple (AAPL) Market Valuation Declined While Stillwater Investment Management Has Boosted Holding by $5.54 Million
May 12, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Stillwater Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 109.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stillwater Investment Management Llc bought 53,250 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 101,851 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.68 million, up from 48,601 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stillwater Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $188.59. About 25.70 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Loring Wolcott & Coolidge Fiduciary Advisors Llp decreased its stake in Exxon Mobil Corp (XOM) by 1.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Loring Wolcott & Coolidge Fiduciary Advisors Llp sold 10,366 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.23% with the market. The institutional investor held 959,843 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $80.28 million, down from 970,209 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Loring Wolcott & Coolidge Fiduciary Advisors Llp who had been investing in Exxon Mobil Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $344.13 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.47% or $0.38 during the last trading session, reaching $81.28. About 14.75M shares traded. Exxon Mobil Corporation (NYSE:XOM) has declined 9.29% since May 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.84% the S&P500.
